question: In which legal jurisdiction(s) will originated lines be used, and are player props, Same-Game Parlays, or competition rewards permitted there?
known_info: NFL widgets redirect to licensed US bookmakers (FanDuel, Caesars, DraftKings); in the Netherlands, Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) regulates licensed online operators and restricts specific bet types.
missing_info: Target operating jurisdiction, licensed sportsbook list, prohibited prop categories under local law, and legal classification of leaderboard rewards.
discovery_suggestion: Confirm operating jurisdiction with counsel and check the Ksa Kansspelwijzer license register or applicable state gaming commission rules.

question: Which official NFL injury, roster, play-by-play, and Next Gen Stats feeds are legally licensed for automated ingestion and storage?
known_info: NFL.com publicly renders weekly injury tables, player stats (1970–2026), and Next Gen Stats glossaries/leaderboards for browser viewing.
missing_info: Commercial/automated scraping permissions, official API feed pricing (e.g., Genius Sports / official NFL data partners), rate limits, and redistribution rights.
discovery_suggestion: Review NFL.com Terms of Service and request commercial/research data-licensing quotes from official NFL data distributors before automating scrapers.

question: Which sportsbook's timestamped opening/closing lines, betting limits, and push/void/DNP rules define the execution benchmark?
known_info: NFL.com does not take bets itself; its widgets display prices from partner bookmakers. NGCB reports statewide football pool win% of 5.05% (12-month).
missing_info: Historical point-in-time odds archive, SGP leg void/re-pricing house rules when an active player exits early or is inactive, and maximum stake limits.
discovery_suggestion: Acquire a licensed timestamped odds dataset and archive exact house settlement rules for every target sportsbook before scoring backtests.

question: At what exact timestamp before kickoff must originated lines and strategy signals lock to match official lineup certainty?
known_info: Official NFL Game Operations rules mandate club delivery of the Game Day Administration Report (Inactive List + C2P helmets + roof status) 90 minutes before kickoff, with final roof position at 60 minutes.
verified_answer: Official Inactive List cutoff is 90 minutes pre-kickoff; stadium roof/wall position locks 60 minutes pre-kickoff (project model lock window still requires owner selection).
missing_info: Whether strategies will target early-week openers (high uncertainty, higher limits drift) or post-T-90m confirmed-lineup markets.
discovery_suggestion: Test separate origination cohorts for Early-Week (Wednesday/Thursday practice report) vs. Confirmed-Active (T-85m post-inactive release).

question: How do we establish authoritative 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th string replacement order when club depth charts carry 'unofficial' disclaimers and lag IR moves?
known_info: Official club sites (patriots.com, detroitlions.com, baltimoreravens.com, etc.) publish 1st–4th string tables, but explicitly note PR/writer compilation and retain some IR players (e.g., Lamar Jackson) in 1st-string slots.
missing_info: Historical post-game snap participation by alignment (slot CB vs. boundary CB, LG vs. C swing) and Practice Squad standard elevation announcements.
discovery_suggestion: Build a 4-layer reconciliation pipeline: (1) 53-man + IR transaction log, (2) weekly club depth chart, (3) T-90m inactives, and (4) official post-game participation snaps.

question: How many times per regular season may a Practice Squad backup (often 3rd or 4th string) be elevated without clearing waivers?
known_info: NFL Operations' Contract Language page states in adjacent paragraphs both 'maximum of two regular-season or postseason games' and 'maximum of three regular season games in the same League Year'.
missing_info: Authoritative 2026 NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) side-letter text resolving the 2-game vs. 3-game wording discrepancy on operations.nfl.com.
discovery_suggestion: Verify directly against the executed NFL-NFLPA CBA Standard Elevation Addendum text before hard-coding elevation-cap alerts.

question: Which pairwise bet correlations remain stable out of sample across coaching schemes, weather regimes, and backup QB/OL substitutions?
known_info: Binary correlation (phi) does not uniquely determine multi-leg parlay joint probabilities when >2 legs interact or when injury regimes shift run/pass splits.
missing_info: Multi-season empirical correlation matrices stratified by spread magnitude, total, roof/weather, and starter vs. backup QB status.
discovery_suggestion: Compute season-by-season block-bootstrapped correlation matrices from aligned play-by-play and historical prop lines; reject pairs whose sign or magnitude is unstable.

question: What exact sample size (N), Brier/Log-Loss improvement margin, and False Discovery Rate (alpha) must a strategy beat to pass validation?
known_info: Proper scoring rules (Log Loss, Brier Score) decompose into reliability, resolution, and outcome uncertainty; small samples conflate luck with resolution.
missing_info: Owner-approved statistical power target (e.g., alpha = 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across M trials, minimum N_eff >= 250 independent game clusters).
discovery_suggestion: Run Monte Carlo power simulations under realistic NFL vig (4.5%–6.7% singles; 8%–28% parlays) to lock minimum N_eff before opening leaderboard submissions.

question: How are leaderboard rewards funded, denominated, audited, and protected against multi-entry variance gaming ('sybil strategies')?
known_info: If a participant submits 20 uncorrelated high-variance strategies for free, the best one can appear profitable over a short window purely by chance.
missing_info: Reward budget/type (recognition vs. cash/compute), per-author submission caps, prospective lock duration, and tie-breaking governance.
discovery_suggestion: Establish strict identity-bound submission quotas, count all submitted variants per author in multiple-testing haircuts, and require prospective shadow weeks.

question: How will weather observations be captured identically for US outdoor stadiums and NFL International Series venues?
known_info: NWS Web API provides free US grid forecasts, while 2026 NFL schedules include international games (e.g., Madrid, Munich, London referenced on club/NFL pages).
missing_info: Official meteorological API for non-US NFL venues and archived point-in-time forecast snapshots (not retroactive station actuals).
discovery_suggestion: Pair api.weather.gov for US venues with UK Met Office / DWD / AEMET official national meteorological APIs and archive pre-kickoff forecasts.

question: How much have the 2026 kickoff (6-1-3, 6-1-5), anytime declared onside kick (6-1-6), and disqualification (19-2) rule changes shifted scoring and comeback rates?
known_info: The 2026 NFL Rulebook officially enacted four rule changes (6-1-3, 6-1-5, 6-1-6, 19-2) affecting kickoff alignments, 50-yard kickoff touchbacks, and onside kicks.

question: Which official feed takes precedence when NFL.com injury tables, NFL.com news reports, and club depth charts disagree mid-week?
known_info: In Week 10 (2026-11-12), nfl.com/injuries/ showed blank Injury/Game Status on many Sunday players and conflicted with news headlines and club two-deep listings.
missing_info: Formal conflict-resolution hierarchy and automated quarantine rules when two official NFL properties publish conflicting player statuses.
discovery_suggestion: Adopt a strict source hierarchy: (1) T-90m Game Day Inactive Report for active status, (2) Friday/Wednesday final Game Status column, (3) Quarantine conflicting pre-Friday signals.
